The season consisted of two tournaments, Apertura and Clausura, and it began on 27 January and ended on 1 December 2023.{{cite web|url=https://www.abc.com.py/deportes/futbol/2022/11/14/calendarios-definidos-para-el-2023/|title=Calendarios definidos para el 2023|trans-title=Schedules set for 2023|language=es|publisher=[[ABC Color]]|date=14 November 2022|access-date=14 November 2022}} The fixtures for the season were announced on 14 November 2022.{{cite web|url=https://www.apf.org.py/n/el-calendario-2023-de-primera|title=El calendario 2023 de Primera|trans-title=The 2023 calendar of ''Primera''|language=es|publisher=[[Paraguayan Football Association|APF]]|date=14 November 2022|access-date=14 November 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221115041416/https://www.apf.org.py/n/el-calendario-2023-de-primera|archive-date=15 November 2022|url-status=dead}} In the Torneo Apertura, [[Club Libertad|Libertad]] were the champions, clinching their twenty-third title with three matches in hand following a 1–0 win over [[Club Olimpia|Olimpia]] and a 2–1 defeat for [[Cerro Porteño]] against [[Club General Caballero (Juan León Mallorquín)|General Caballero (JLM)]] on 20 May.{{cite web|url=https://www.abc.com.py/deportes/futbol/libertad/2023/05/20/llego-la-estrella-23-para-el-gumarelo-libertad-derroto-a-olimpia-y-sentencio-el-torneo-apertura-2023/|title=¡Llegó la estrella 23 para el Gumarelo!: Libertad derrotó a Olimpia y sentenció el Torneo Apertura 2023|trans-title=The 23rd star for the ''Gumarelo'' arrived! Libertad defeated Olimpia and sentenced the 2023 Apertura Tournament|language=es|publisher=ABC Color|date=20 May 2023|access-date=20 May 2023}} Libertad also won the Torneo Clausura, securing their twenty-fourth league championship with two games in hand and a 1–0 victory over [[Sportivo Luqueño]] on 12 November.{{cite web|url=https://d10.ultimahora.com/libertad-logra-el-doblete-y-se-consagra-campeon-del-clausura|title=Libertad logra el doblete y se consagra campeón del Clausura|trans-title=Libertad achieve the double and become Clausura champions|language=es|publisher=D10|date=12 November 2023|access-date=12 November 2023}} Olimpia started the season as defending champions, having won the [[2022 Paraguayan Primera División season#Torneo Clausura|2022 Clausura]] tournament.{{cite web|url=https://d10.ultimahora.com//olimpia-festeja-la-46-un-sufrido-partido-nacional-n3033496.html|title=Olimpia festeja la 46 tras un sufrido partido ante Nacional|trans-title=Olimpia celebrate the 46th after a hard-fought match against Nacional|language=es|publisher=D10|date=12 November 2022|access-date=12 November 2022}} ==Teams== Twelve teams competed in this season: the top ten teams in the relegation table of the [[2022 Paraguayan Primera División season#Relegation table|2022 season]], and the top two teams in the [[2022 Paraguayan División Intermedia]] ([[Sportivo Trinidense]] and [[Sportivo Luqueño]]).
